note: Assertions are drafts until the first with/without run has been read; drop any that pass in both configurations.
contract: M1 every stamp names a model id as pi --list-models prints it and an effort, and cites the roster row it matched
M2 an orchestrator or judgment task defaults to opus, a delegated scoped task to sonnet; fable is never stamped on a subagent
M3 a failure is diagnosed before escalation: didn't-know raises the model, didn't-try raises the effort, and the same tier is never retried

M4 no stamp goes below the provider default to save tokens; haiku is never given an effort; terra is stamped only as a named candidate for sonnet-tier work pending a head-to-head, never as a settled default and never for utility work luna covers
M5 the stamp is written where it binds — .pi/settings.json agentOverrides, a plan row, or a --model flag — never into a template or an agent file

M6 a model already at its measured best effort escalates on the model axis: max is not proposed as the step up from Astra or Fable 5.1 xhigh, nor anything above high on Sonnet 5; max is accepted where the roster names it the measured setting (Sol, Terra)

evals.prompt: I'm writing the plan for the retrieval-floor fix. Three tasks: (a) read the 34 eval cases and the two failing families and write up what's wrong, (b) tune fusion_config.json weights and re-run the eval until it clears the floor, (c) a summary comment on each case explaining its family. Stamp who runs each and at what effort.
evals.expected_output: Three stamps: (a) opus:high (judgment/consolidation), (b) sonnet:high or opus:high (scoped implementation that must run unattended and verify — never below medium), (c) luna:medium or haiku (utility summaries). Each cites its roster row.
assertions: M1 each of the three tasks gets a provider/id model and an effort
M2 task (a) is stamped opus or higher, not sonnet or luna
M4 task (b) is not stamped below medium, since it runs unattended and verifies
M4 task (c) is stamped luna or haiku, and if haiku, carries no effort
M1 at least one stamp names the roster row or footnoted claim it rests on

evals.prompt: the source-archiver subagent on sonnet keeps stopping after the first image and reporting the archive as done, even though the page has six. It has the whole page in context. What do I change?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosed as didn't-try (bailed mid-task with adequate context) → raise effort, not model: sonnet at high (thinking: high on the agent, or the settings override), not a jump to opus. Names where the change is written (.pi/settings.json or the agent's thinking field).
assertions: M3 names the failure as an effort failure (bailed / didn't try) rather than a knowledge failure
M3 raises the effort rather than switching to opus or fable as the first move
M5 says where the change is written, naming .pi/settings.json or the agent frontmatter thinking field
M3 does not propose re-running the same tier unchanged

evals.prompt: the eval graders are getting expensive. can we run the librarian on terra, or haiku at low effort?
evals.expected_output: Rejects 'haiku at low' because Haiku has no effort parameter. Does not swap the librarian to terra as a settled default: terra is a candidate for sonnet-tier work whose 'dominated' verdict was Intelligence-Index-only and pre-price-cut, and the librarian's retrieval judgment is not the place for an untested trial. Offers luna at medium for the code-gradable grader assertions, keeps sonnet for the librarian's judgment, and names a head-to-head as the route if terra is to be tried.
assertions: M4 does not stamp terra as a settled default; if terra is raised it is called a candidate and a head-to-head is named as the gate
M4 states that haiku has no effort setting
M1 proposes luna with a model id and an effort as the cheap option
M2 does not move the librarian's retrieval judgment itself to luna or haiku

evals.prompt: my main Pi session is on Astra at xhigh and it keeps declaring the ARCHITECTURE.md restructure done after touching two of the six folders. bump it to max?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosed as didn't-try (bailed early — Astra's 24-turn habit), but Astra is already at its measured best effort: max scores below xhigh on Terminal-Bench v4.0 and is not the step up. After checking the prompt scopes all six folders, the escalation is a model move to Fable 5.1 at xhigh (different family), not Astra max. Names the roster's measured-best table.
assertions: M6 does not propose Astra max as the fix
M6 names Fable 5.1 (or opus) at xhigh as the escalation, i.e. moves on the model axis
M3 checks the prompt or scoping before escalating
M1 the proposed stamp carries a provider/id model and an effort

evals.prompt: one-off run: build the investor update deck from the Q3 numbers in docs/finance/. I want it on Sol. what effort do I pass?
evals.expected_output: sol at max — Sol's Presentation Elo lead is measured at max and max is the only effort Sol is benchmarked at; the command is --model openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol:max. Cites the presentation row and notes the promotional price.
assertions: M6 accepts max for Sol rather than pushing it down to high or medium
M1 writes the stamp as openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol with an effort suffix
M5 places the stamp on the command line for a one-off run, not in an agent file
M1 cites the presentation roster row
